findings.detail: A07 observed pct_sum is 0.0%, but the filing schedule total reports Total Investments at 202.01% of net assets.

rationale: Class 3 aggregate review. The raw source SOI total row reports Total Investments fair value of 24,973.4 and 202.01% of net assets, while the flagged extraction/check artifact reports pct_sum=0.0%. The filing source therefore decides the issue as a missing or unmapped percent-of-net-assets extraction, not a valid zero percent total.
